title: Huang Renxun: Opposes Slowing Down AI Development, the US Will Continue to Expand AI Infrastructure

content_html:
On Monday morning, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang had a live call with U.S. President Trump at the All-In Summit in Los Angeles, where they discussed the speed of AI development and the controversy over data center construction. Huang was speaking with the hosts of the "All-In" podcast, investor Chamath Palihapitiya, Jason Calacanis, David Friedberg, and David Sacks, and he shared Trump's words through a speaker for the audience present.

Previously, Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, had called for "slowing down" the advancement of artificial intelligence capabilities, and both Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX, and Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, publicly expressed their support. Huang, however, held a different view, suggesting that such proposals might align with forces that do not want the AI industry to continue developing. During the call, Trump stated that the United States would not slow down AI development due to political factors or external influences such as China, and he said, "They will not succeed," which Huang agreed with.
